author: OPTOBAT
body:
Hey everyone, I've finally finished editing and uploading Episode 5 of my nebula series on Avicus!
I know some people have been waiting for it so I'm pleased to give you a link to it here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kl2843mQYrA

Please, if you enjoy the video, be sure to like and maybe even subscribe :)

This video highlights my whereabouts, 2 monuments (first of the series), and my first prestige.

Thanks guys, glad to be back on YouTube :D
